name: SureDash
author: Brainstorm Force

sections.description:
SureDash transforms your WordPress site into a vibrant community hub. Create a unified login and dashboard experience to boost user engagement—all within your WordPress environment.

Unlike standalone platforms like Circle, SureDash integrates seamlessly with your existing WordPress setup. Keep full control over your data and customize the experience to fit your brand.

Try the live demo of SureDash.

Key Benefits

  • Seamless Integration: Enhance your WordPress site with community features.
  • Customizable Design: Tailor the dashboard and features to match your brand’s look and feel.
  • Scalable Solution: Add new spaces as needed.

Free Features

  • Custom login and registration forms
  • Visual customizer for dashboard layout
  • User profiles
  • Activity feeds for updates and engagement
  • Discussion forums with threaded replies (only site admin can post, but all members can comment)
  • Multiple discussions for focused sub-communities
  • Giphy integration for animated GIFs

SureDash Premium

  • Learning management system course builder
  • Enable users to post in discussion feeds
  • Private discussion feeds
  • Resource library
  • Events (coming soon)
  • Support from our team

Perfect For

  • Membership sites
  • Online courses
  • Customer support hubs
  • Niche communities

Links

  • Visit SureDash
  • Get Support
  • Try Test Drive
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/suredash directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to SureDash > Settings to configure your dashboard.
sections.faq:
How can I report a security bug?

We take plugin security extremely seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it in a safe and responsible manner.

You can report the issue through our Bug Bounty Program.
sections.changelog:
1.4.3 – 04th November 2025

  • New: Introducing integration with OttoKit to manage your portal with automation. ( https://suredash.com/docs/integrate-ottokit-with-suredash/ )
  • Improvement: Introducing some helpful developer hooks to extend SureDash functionality by custom or third-party app owners. ( https://suredash.com/docs/ottokit-hooks-reference/#suredash-core-hooks )
  • Improvement: Introduced ‘suredash_customize_portal_link’ filter to allow customization of the portal link.
  • Improvement: SureForms compatibility has improved.
  • Fix: The Thumbnail Image option for the space setting was not synced properly with the post featured image option.

1.4.2 – 15th October 2025

  • Fix: Fatal error when for settings page if Bypass WordPress Interactions option is disabled.
  • Fix: Login-Register page misaligned with Kadence theme after 1.4.0 update.

1.4.1 – 14th October 2025

  • Fix: Authors unable to edit posts if “Allow Members to Post” option disabled from Discussions space.

1.4.0 – 14th October 2025

  • New: The “Enable Like & Share” option has been separated into two individual settings: “Enable Like Button” and “Enable Share Button”.
  • New: Introduced 2-column layout patterns for Login and Registration form blocks.
  • New: SureCart Integration – You can now select a space in SureDash settings to link with SureCart’s Customer Area page. Customers will be automatically redirected to this selected space after their purchase.
  • New: Portal Identity Block – Added dark mode logo support with separate logo upload options for light and dark themes.
  • New: Blank avatar gets replaced with the user’s initials for users without avatars, for a more personalized experience.
  • New: Introducing “Edit” functionality for posts, allowing authors to edit the post.
  • New: Introducing “Delete” functionality for posts, allowing authors to delete their own post.
  • New: Administrator users can also be listed from the Users > User Roles filter, for better filtering.
  • Improvement: Hardened the security of the plugin.
  • Improvement: Added support for the profile block under the responsive navigation flyout, if it’s being used on the desktop portal-sidebar version.
  • Improvement: Improvised the SureDash post editing flow from the space editor to make it more user-friendly.
  • Improvement: Private community space links now redirect users back to the originally requested space URL once they log in.
  • Fix: Resolved blank screen issue on Portal login & registration pages caused by a conflict with Breakdance.
  • Fix: Spectra block editor icons conflict with SureDash, and block-level icons are not visible in the editor.
  • Fix: Fixed incorrect post count in admin users list after post type change to ‘community-post’.
  • Fix: Logging out from the portal now redirects to the portal-login page instead of the main site URL.
  • Tweak: Link space single view now automatically redirects to the assigned custom URL.
  • Tweak: Lesson name gets encoded from SureDash Pro.
  • Tweak: Corrected singular-plural like(s) message text for instant likes on a community post.
  • Tweak: Added “Premium” badge for “Allow Members to Post” setting from the free version for clear visibility.

1.3.2 – 16th September 2025

  • New: Login Block – Added a centralized Form Texts section in the block for easier customization of all text options, including new texts for lost password and reset forms.
  • New: Added Breakdance page builder compatibility for SureDash Spaces.
  • New: Introduced an option to remove the uploaded profile photo.
  • Improvement: Portal managers’ validation now only allows users with administrator or editor roles.
  • Improvement: Refined the space creation modal for better user experience.
  • Improvement: Commenting options dropdown UI updated for better user experience.
  • Improvement: Displaying all user comments in the user detail view. Previously, only a limited number of comments were shown.
  • Improvement: Introduced ‘suredash_community_post_slug’ and ‘suredash_community_content_slug’ filters fo updating URL slug for SureDash Posts and Community Content respectively.
  • Fix: When a SureDash user role user tags someone, the mentioned user’s name is not getting highlighted.
  • Fix: Fixed Breakdance conflicts with SureDash portal routes.
  • Fix: Browser tab title now shows correct page names for Profile and Bookmarks pages instead of “Portal Space – SureDash”.
  • Fix: Portal Identity Block – When elements’ visibility set to both as “Title + Logo”, then the title is not visible on the frontend.
  • Tweak: Mentioned user tag highlight color was not linked to the global color palette.

1.3.1 – 03rd September 2025

  • Improvement: Color Switcher block added by default to Classic and Modern portal patterns.
  • Improvement: Post dates are now displayed in the relative time format (e.g., “2 days ago”, “2 weeks ago”) for better readability.
  • Improvement: On user’s view page, posts are now shown in reverse chronological order.
  • Fix: After instant update from 1.2 to 1.3 the post submit button is not visible on the discussion posts.

1.3.0 – 29th August 2025

  • New: Compatibility of Resource Library Space with the SureDash premium plugin. (https://suredash.com/docs/setup-resource-library/)
  • New: Introducing the Default Colour Palette, Light-Dark Colours setting under the Customize Portal. (https://suredash.com/docs/global-color-palette-explained/)
  • New: Introducing Colour Switcher block to allow user to switch between light and dark color modes. (https://suredash.com/docs/fix-global-color-palette-missing-message/)
  • New: Introducing “Enable Like & Share Buttons” space-level option to control the visibility of like and share buttons for a frontend space view.
  • New: Introducing “Custom CSS” settings in the dashboard to allow users to add custom CSS for the portal.
  • New: Added “Show Hidden Spaces” option in the dashboard, allowing users to restore spaces they previously hid for a cleaner and more concise listing view.
  • New: Introduced a new Feeds Icon for the Feeds Page in the side navigation.
  • Improvement: Adjusted the entire portal with SureDash default colours for better consistency with light-dark modes.
  • Improvement: Updated the single post/page space editor flow fora better user experience.
  • Improvement: Excluded portal login & registration pages from WordPress home page display settings to avoid conflict.
  • Improvement: Introduced new filters ‘suredashboard_uploads_base’, ‘suredash_user_avatar_markup’, ‘suredash_inserting_default_post_status’ for better customization.
  • Improvement: Updated responsive side navigation icon for a better visual experience.
  • Fix: Bricks Compatibility – Themify, Font Awesome icon showing broken on the space frontend view.
  • Fix: Link Space – Resolved 404 error when opening Link Space in a new tab from the admin dashboard.
  • Fix: Notifications – New registered users are getting notifications since the beginning of the portal instead of the registered date.
  • Fix: Elementor Pro compatibility: Page transitions causes user logout issue when visiting profile or bookmarks sub-page.
  • Fix: Resolved issue where newly uploaded Profile Photo and Cover Image were not showing correctly.
  • Fix: Reset password emails now correctly use the updated login page slug/URL instead of always defaulting to portal-login.
  • Fix: PHP Error – “Uncaught TypeError: array_key_exists(): Argument #2 ($array) must be of type array, bool given”.
  • Fix: Single post preview and portal content now correctly use space-specific layout settings instead of global layout settings.
  • Fix: Modern Layout – Notification count showing double count.
  • Tweak: Removed bookmark icon for Space for non-logged-in users.
  • Tweak: Improved the dynamic tags drag-drop behaviour to copy the shorthand properties flow.
  • Tweak: Smoothen the Portal manager selection & removal workflow from User Roles settings.
